deviations.what: the decider is Gemma directly: each utterance plus a rolling context goes to the lobes senses role (Gemma-4-26B-A4B), which returns a structured decision (class, intent, confidence); this repo's code treats it as untrusted input and still enforces policy.may_act, whitelist, power-only argument validation, rate limits and the strict-mode delay; if senses is down, slow or malformed the agent does nothing
deviations.reason: user decision 2026-09-18: the product must not rest on a pre-set group of phrasings; an agent has to decide

deviations.what: the rule/lexicon classifier built in t10 is removed from the runtime and kept only as a test oracle and as the seed corpus of the golden set; the guarantee that a spoken command never acts in strict mode is no longer proven deterministically but evidenced by the golden set run against the real model (temperature 0, zero strict-mode actions on command fixtures as a hard threshold)
deviations.reason: user decision 2026-09-18: chose to remove the rules from the runtime, re-affirmed after the consequence was spelled out

deviations.what: the agent carries a trimmed rolling context window (recent utterances, current mode and AC state) into each model call, in memory only, gone on restart; this is the intended meaning of the 25h requirement
deviations.reason: user clarification 2026-09-18: c29 was about an agent's accumulated context, which the first spec reading reduced to buffer bounds

deviations.what: t17 becomes a local golden set: a committed manifest of utterances with expected class, intent and would-act; TTS-only audio kept local (gitignored, regenerable); two entrances, audio through the full path and text sent directly to Gemma, run against the real model on the box under a pytest marker that never runs in CI; default CI runs use a fake decider replaying recorded decisions
deviations.reason: user request 2026-09-18: a golden set for local tests so integration is tested on the real model

deltas.behavior_text: what kind of speech an utterance is gets decided by a local language model (lobes senses, Gemma) returning class/intent/confidence, not by a rule cascade; this repo's code still refuses anything labelled a command in strict mode
the deterministic guarantee that a spoken command is recognised as a command: the rule/lexicon classifier is no longer in the runtime path and serves only as a test oracle
a trimmed rolling context window of recent utterances, mode and AC state is sent with every model call; in memory only, gone on restart
a local golden set (275-row manifest, runner with text, audio-batch and audio-realtime entrances, thresholds, replay recording) exists; it has NOT been run against the real model
the listener exits with code 3 when the lobes session freezes, so the restart policy recovers it; previously sys.exit on the reader thread ended only that thread and run() returned 0
operator controls from the CLI are capped by the listener's own --apply flag: a dry-run listener cannot be made to actuate from the CLI
dashboard and CLI controls skip the mode gate and the already-in-state check by design, while sharing the whitelist, argument validation and rate limiter with the voice path
